summary: Secret-choices trace 15 [Hearts] (seed 0x67932): participants who left while the space's host was away got stand-ins the moment the host came back. While the host is away the room counts nobody as present, so everyone's time away ran from the host's departure and nothing paused it; only an outage of the room itself paused time away. A custom game now stops counting time away while nobody in the space is present and resumes it when the host is back.
